item.title: Amazon pledges $1 billion for community college and home energy upgrades
item.description: The company said it will also fund job training and energy-efficiency upgrades as hyperscalers face community pushback over data centers.

item.title: Nvidia-backed Reflection AI launches first open model, Beam
item.description: The New York-based company has deals with several U.S. government agencies and billion-dollar compute agreements.

item.title: U.S. shale executives uncertain when oil market will decline sharply
item.description: More than half see substantial margin remaining, while one-third of oil executives think the SPR is already below or nearly at tank bottoms.

item.title: NYSE owner and OKX seek SEC approval for tokenized US stock trading
item.description: The move by OKXICE comes three months after former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo became its cochair.
